sourceHashMethod: SHA256; UTF-8 text without BOM, CRLF normalized to LF; PNG bytes unchanged
lightControl: Stage tint/emission group Emit.W and spill Base.Y independently masked; AR key patches and projected note-light spill independently gated. Static lighting/depression unchanged; default-off review seams only.
cameraMethod: Reference synthetic BGRA; other views nearest-neighbour planar reprojection with calibration-matched corners. Not re-lit 3D or real-camera evidence.
sheetOrder: two quartets: particles off/on; TL neither, TR tint, BL spill, BR both; native pixels
coverageMethod: Raw live pool; Stage-eligible alpha >.003 surface candidates; actually packed Stage/AR callbacks. Absolute-age bins 0/.2/.4 seconds; not screen-space visibility. Sorted sample hashes (pitch,age,life); AR cap unchanged at 192.
metric: 8-bit display RGB differences only; >4 footprint is not brightness, quality or an additive decomposition.
geometryMethod: Actual packed corners in output pixels; edge lengths and center-Y range, not visible shader area. Candidate preserves geometry hash exactly.
